steps.name: Kali exchange support (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus,” go to [Noel].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you for your interest in supporting exchanges with the Kali people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then can you tell me? I'd like to try it if I can... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course. Do you know anything about the Kali people?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I have no idea.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The Kali are one of Eastland's many ethnic groups.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Currently, the Kali people live in the village 'Kali' somewhere in the Land of Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's somewhere... . Are you saying you don't know exactly where it is?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That's right. They say that perhaps only those with strong powers or special people can discover it. Maybe someone like Shinik will be able to find it soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… , Does that mean that there is someone there with the same level of power as Shinik? I think they put a device in place to prevent people like that from coming in... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That's right. You understand quickly. Medea, the leader of the Kali tribe, is one of the superhumans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to meet you soon.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik entrusted me with interacting with other superhumans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't it because it's not fun at all and it's annoying?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehehe. Maybe so, maybe not.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If the Dark Kingdom of Deimos decides to target our city, the Kingdom of Jude and Luman will be in danger.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: So we try to maintain as close a relationship with superhumans as possible.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: We are cooperating to some extent with Lumen, including Jiscard, but we are in complete disrepair with people from other regions, except for our common enemy, Vice.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Adkina of the Land of Illusion is in the Valley of the Dragon, but it is a place where ordinary humans cannot enter.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Besides, the Blizzard Empress is too far away... . The evil king is a person who cannot communicate... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I'm trying to interact with the closest superhuman with the highest potential.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I think that would be best. One of the reasons I think positively is because Shinik seems to have interacted with the Kali people in the past.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's been a long time since we interacted... . Noel said that in order to resume exchanges, it would be a good idea to obtain goods from overseas and deliver them.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: The person who wants to interact more than anyone else is Noel, a member of the Kali tribe. Please go and listen to the story.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then I leave it to you. Perhaps this task... may ultimately be for the god you serve, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll talk to Noel first. I'll be back. And please tell Shinik well about me.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Please don't worry about that. Hehehe.

steps.name: Kali exchange support (2)
steps.objective: Obtain <Stimulant for Dreamers>, <Magic Sea Drop>, and <Pearl Embracing Darkness> and report them to [Layer] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Awesome Adventurer! Please buy me just one item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm kind of cool, but... . Isn’t it too much of a commercial smile?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: There is no choice if you want to make a living. If you don't buy it, come later. It's cool, but it's not cool at all... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't that too mean? Ah, the reason I came to see Noel was because Melvik asked me to go… .

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes? Are you Melvik? Is that handsome Mr. Melvik? What did you say about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I talk about Mr. Melvik, his attitude changes completely.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Huh, did I do that? sorry. Please speak. If Mr. Melvik sends you, I will listen to everything!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Noel the story you had with Melvik.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Huh, really? Are you asking for those items? So far, I haven't seen anyone willing to come forward and save the day... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? First of all, it is an important matter.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Adventurer You also want something from our Kali people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no impure intention. I have work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain to Noel why I came to Tartarus and what my intention is to help support exchanges among the Kali people.)

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Yes, I understand. At least now that I know that you are not using the Kali clan for bad things, I will tell you what items my clan needs.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thank you. Even though I don't deserve to be seen for fighting with the villagers and running away, I want to be helpful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you too. I promise. So, could you put some of the items for sale in front of my eyes?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Sheesh, that doesn't work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll buy you a lot later, so I'll go get those items.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Oh, that's right. If you find the items, please bring them to Layer. They will store it well in the warehouse. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And… ?

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Please convey your kind words to Mr. Melvik. Noel said it with great care.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass it on that way. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 노엘
lines.text: Thank you for caring about our family. Then please take care of yourself.

steps.name: Kali exchange support (3)
steps.objective: Visit the princess of a certain kingdom.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I heard the story from Noel. They said they had prepared items for exchange with the Kali people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's here.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Then I will keep it safe in the warehouse. When the time comes, I will hand it to Melvik.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I met Medea of the Kali tribe a long time ago, and it reminds me of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious what kind of person you are. I think I'll have to meet you someday... .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I don't know if it will be helpful, but would you like to hear the story briefly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: When I was young, I was a mercenary who did whatever it took to make money. It's a shame, but there's an old nickname called 'the beast of the desert'.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: After finishing work, I was returning to Jude Kingdom alone, but my mind became cloudy and I collapsed. Perhaps that place was the Land of Illusion near Tartarus.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I thought I was going to collapse and die like this in a place with no information... .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Fortunately, when I opened my eyes, I found myself in a mysterious village where people with animal ears lived. That place was Cali.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: With the help of the leader there, Medea, I was able to recover quickly and quickly return to Jude Kingdom.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It's really amazing. I've experienced many healing magics, but I've never seen anything as pure, clean, and powerful as his power... .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I thought it was like a goddess incarnate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since he is a superhuman, doesn't he have that much power?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I guess so... ? That was already 30 years ago.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I mean honey. If you're doing it for the sake of exchange, why don't you get me one more thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of object is it?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: It's one book. Medea likes books, but she expressed regret that there were books she couldn't get because it was such a remote village.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I think it would be better if I brought the book Medea was looking for in addition to the items I got... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of book is it??

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: They say it's a book containing someone's memories. I don't know much about it, but I heard it was a book that a princess on a distant continent made at her own expense and gave it away for free... .

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Do you know anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, if it’s that book….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I remember.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I'm happy to think of Medea, who found the book and is reading it. Look for it, and if you have the book, bring it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I'm not sure, I'll check the owner of the book first. What I bring is the next story... . Then I will bring you good news quickly. Please wait!

steps.name: Kali exchange support (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Scenario Book 1> from [Herne] in the "Elias Royal Palace" and report it to [Layer] in the "Underground City of Tartarus".

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Wow, Adventurer! I missed Herne a lot!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: What adventures have you had so far? Please stop by!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: I heard that you went to the Eastern Continent and the Continent in the Sky!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Please stop by! Please stop by!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Herne, speak slowly. I'm out of breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, it's okay.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Hehe, sorry. By the way, what brought you here to Herne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It is said that a certain book is needed for exchange between certain towns and cities on different continents.)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: If it were a book made by a princess on a distant continent at her own expense and given out for free... . Umm… .

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Oh, I know!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: This is the book Herne has!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Iris There are still many books that contain my sister’s stories. Please bring it to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Princess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What story would the princess like? Then shall I tell you about the superhumans in the Eastern Continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Herne what happened so far.)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Wow… . It's amazing. Adventurer!!

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: When I grow up, I want to have adventures like Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: (Hejong keeps clearing his throat, probably feeling uncomfortable. Then he looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cough, did I say something unnecessary….)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Hey, look at me for a moment.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: It bothers me that Herne keeps showing interest in the outside world. Your story isn't bad, but it keeps making me anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see what you mean.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Adventurer, can you tell me more? Iris Please tell me about your sister!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Hehe, Herne. Adventurer is busy. If not today, let's talk about it later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Princess, I'm sorry. I have work to do... . See you later, Your Majesty. Goodbye to you too, princess.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Hehe… . It can't be helped. Still, come see Herne again later! Absolutely!

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Seeing that he is in front of me, he must have a book in his hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it wasn't as difficult as I thought.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Is it okay if I take a quick look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: What a fascinating book… . A book full of vague memories... . But I think I’ve heard the name Iris somewhere… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is the name of the girl who defeated the Demon King and became the god of this world, following in the footsteps of Goddess Ceres.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Ah… . Is this the name of a goddess?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Actually, I didn't care who the god was. All I did was just believe in myself and live my life.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Everyone has a sad story, but I think Goddess Iris has an even sadder story.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: I wonder why Medea wanted to get this book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe we can find out when we meet later?

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Because it’s later… . It's a bit lonely because there's no telling when that will happen.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Stop talking about useless things. Thanks to you, I wasn't bored. Because it was fun thanks to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I go to Cali, I will give my regards to Medea.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: Yeah. thank you. Since he is such a special person, he will be able to go to Cali and meet Medea.

lines.speaker: 레이어
lines.text: If you need my help in the future, come to me anytime. Because you can always help. Well then, good luck.
